title: Grilled Salmon with Roasted Vegetables
blurb: Salmon fillets grilled until the skin crisps, served with roasted courgettes, potatoes and onions seasoned with paprika and herbs.
steps: Heat your oven to 200°C and heat your grill to high.
Cut the potatoes into 2cm chunks and the courgettes into thick rounds. Peel and cut the onion into wedges.
Toss the vegetables in a roasting tin with half the olive oil, the paprika, thyme, and half the salt and pepper. Roast for 20 minutes until tender and starting to brown.
Pat the salmon fillets dry and rub with the remaining oil, salt and pepper.
Place the salmon skin-side up under the grill for 3 to 4 minutes, then turn and grill for another 3 to 4 minutes until cooked through.
Serve the salmon on top of the roasted vegetables.
